fees_note: $30 in the summer season, $20 in the primitive season (mid-September to mid-October, no water). Up to 8 people and 2 vehicles. Park entrance fee is separate: $35 per private vehicle, valid 7 days ($25 in the November-April winter season), or the $70 Glacier annual pass; an America the Beautiful pass covers it. Non-US residents 16 and over also pay a $100 nonresident fee each. NPS fee page read 2026-11-07.

entrance.name: 7-day vehicle entrance pass
entrance.waived_by: an America the Beautiful interagency pass

fees_note: $35 a night for standard non-electric sites (group sites $50-70). Park entrance fee extra: $30 per vehicle for 1 day or $35 for 7 days, or the $70 Rocky Mountain annual pass; an America the Beautiful pass covers it. Non-US residents 16 and over pay an extra $100 each unless admitted with an annual or America the Beautiful pass. The camping reservation includes the Timed Entry + Bear Lake Road permit: campers may enter from 1 p.m. on their first day; to enter earlier they need their own timed entry reservation or must arrive outside the timed-entry hours (2026: 9 a.m.-2 p.m. park-wide from May 22 to October 12; Bear Lake Road 5 a.m.-6 p.m. to October 18).
sources: https://www.nps.gov/romo/planyourvisit/fees.htm (1-Day Vehicle $30.00, 7-Day Vehicle $35.00, RMNP annual pass $70.00, non-US residents $100 'unless admitted with an Annual or America the Beautiful Pass'; 'A valid entrance fee or park pass is always required to enter') (read 2026-11-07)
summary: RMNP entrance on top of camping; a camper needs at least 2 days, so the $35 7-day pass (vehicle_stay) is the camper's price; $70 annual; ATB accepted. 1-day $30 kept in the note.
